caption:
The video captures a small cylindrical metal burner resting on a tiered base atop a dark wooden table, set against a red brick wall. A flame burns continuously from the burner's top, anchored by a blue ring at its base and a yellow-white body rising above it. To the right sits a round black digital device whose screen shows changing numeric readouts above a lit green button and a blue dot.

The flame flickers and reshapes, alternating between tall columnar plumes and shorter conical tongues. At moments the yellow body shrinks toward the blue ring before growing again. A yellow-orange puff periodically separates from the flame's tip and drifts upward as a detached blob.

The blue ring at the burner's top stays visible, with small points around its rim. The burner, device, table, and wall remain in essentially fixed screen positions.
